reason: A dsh web plugin that visually renders edit and write tool results as collapsible, syntax-highlighted code comparison panels, with read-only local file lookup for absolute line positioning.

summaries.zh: 在 dsh Web 界面中将 edit 和 write 工具结果显示为可折叠、带语法高亮和行号的修改前后代码对照面板。
summaries.en: Displays dsh Web edit and write tool results as collapsible, syntax-highlighted before-and-after code comparison panels with line numbers.

capabilities: Replaces edit and write tool cards with collapsible before-and-after code diff panels
Reads local file contents through a read-only host endpoint to locate diff hunk line numbers
Performs client-side syntax highlighting and diff layout rendering
